questions.stem: If a cube is painted on all faces and then cut into 27 smaller cubes, how many small cubes have exactly 3 painted faces?

hint.level_0: A big painted cube was cut into small cubes. Where a small cube sat decides how many painted faces it has.
hint.level_1: Corners get 3 painted faces, edge cubes get 2, face-centre cubes get 1 — and the cubes hidden INSIDE get 0.
hint.level_2: For an n × n × n cube, the hidden inner block is (n − 2)³. Work out n first, then (n − 2)³ = ?
